title: U.S. general warns Pentagon he lacks sufficient forces to protect Israel
summary_full: A shortage of Navy destroyers, used to defend against Iranian ballistic missile attacks, will force the head of U.S. European Command to prioritize the U.S. homeland instead, officials said.
